summary: Launch Pointe (City of Lake Elsinore): rates $60-125 on Campspot, weekend 2-night block, 50 A full hookups everywhere, rigs to 60 ft, all back-in. Over $50 at the cheapest night ($60 Sun-Thu, $54 with Good Sam 10%), but city-owned, so no price-gate drop. Waterfront: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (the campground's loop road and its used beach lie between the pads and the water). Nightly share ~2/3 (121 nightly RV sites; sites 1-58 long-term only). Website moved to launch-pointe.com; phone added. Note rewritten (it said south shore).
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview (stored value not --AWH). The SE pad row's nearest pads (~33.6735,-117.3725) are on the inland side of the campground's own paved loop road. Beyond the road come a riprap edge and the park's sand beach, which Esri shows with a parked vehicle and people on it. The water is ~150-160 m away (~33.6722,-117.3710). The DEM puts the sand flat at 383-381 m, so even near spill level (~382.5 m) the water stays ~60-100 m beyond the road. A loop road plus the park's own beach in between = view at best. No site number is within 50 m of water over unused open ground. Premium Deluxe #100 is sold as 'a lake-front view'.

PRICE: the cheapest real RV night is Standard (rigs to 35 ft) at $60 Sun-Thu (Campspot $63 with its fee), or $54 with the Good Sam 10% the stored discounts claim. That is over US$50, but the park is city-owned (ownership local), so the private-park price gate does not apply; reported for the reviewer. Summer weekend peak: Premium $105, Premium Deluxe $125.

LONG-STAY: sites 1-58 are 'Traditional' long-term only ($1,400/month, 60-night minimum, up to 4 months), and the Premium loop 73-99 also takes 'Snowbird' monthly stays. Campspot sells 121 RV sites by the night (types listed above), so roughly two thirds of the RV sites are nightly. Google 4.4 (930 reviews).
